summary: Identifies production-relevant components that update periodically/frequently but lack safe updaters

update_gaps.production_role: Core routing proxy for all LLM models on port 8080
update_gaps.why_update_needed: Active upstream development (32 releases in last 90 days), bug fixes, improved process termination, connection pooling. Router is the single point of failure for all LLM inference.
update_gaps.current_update_method: Manual binary download and file replacement
update_gaps.proposed_updater_type: PowerShell script (K:\Project\OpenHands-Update\scripts\update-llama-swap.ps1) with GitHub release discovery, SHA256 check, station stopped gate, -CheckOnly, -DryRun, config test, and atomic binary rollback
update_gaps.required_validation: Station stopped check, config.yaml syntax test with candidate exe, port 8080 binding test, /health 200 check, /v1/models endpoint check
update_gaps.rollback_strategy: Retain previous llama-swap.exe as llama-swap.exe.bak; atomic copy restoration

update_gaps.production_role: Primary Web UI and Ingress Controller
update_gaps.why_update_needed: Existing update-openhands.ps1 lacks modern safety gates established in Stage 7B: has no -CheckOnly mode, no -DryRun mode, automatically restarts station, and immediately attempts live npm install if new version exists.
update_gaps.proposed_updater_type: Harden K:\Project\OpenHands-Update\scripts\update-openhands.ps1 with -CheckOnly, -DryRun, station stopped gate, decoupled restart (-RestartPlatform), and defaults.json version inspection
update_gaps.required_validation: Station stopped check, npm tarball extraction to staging dir, build/ asset hash inspection, patcher dry-run, localization parity check

update_gaps.component: OpenHands Agent Server / Automation Backend Visibility
update_gaps.production_role: Background FastAPI services executed by uvx
update_gaps.why_update_needed: agent-server and automation have independent releases on PyPI that can diverge from agent-canvas. When agent-canvas updates, defaults.json changes version pins automatically. There is currently no pre-update visibility tool reporting what backend versions will be pulled.
update_gaps.proposed_updater_type: Integrate backend PyPI version inspection into update-openhands.ps1 -CheckOnly output
update_gaps.required_validation: Verify PyPI availability and agent-client-protocol constraints before updating agent-canvas
update_gaps.rollback_strategy: Revert agent-canvas package, which restores previous defaults.json
